bagPolicy.summary: No backpacks or large bags over 11”x17” are allowed. Diaper and medical bags are permitted.
bagPolicy.note: Diaper and medical bags are permitted.

parking.note: There is no official parking garage affiliated with the venue, but nearby options are available. Limited valet parking is offered at the W Hotel for ACL Live ticketholders on a first-come, first-served basis. Metered parking starts at $2 per hour and varies by time and day.

rideshare.note: Let Lyft be your ride to the action! Use code ACLLIVELYFT for 50% off your first 2 rides (up to $10/ride).

concessions.note: The venue is cashless, and all concessions, bars, and merchandise stands accept credit/debit cards and mobile payments only. No specific food or drink options are detailed on the page.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Austin City Limits Music Festival, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Austin City Limits Music Festival's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Austin City Limits Music Festival. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Austin City Limits Music Festival. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
